categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai V-Test Semiconductor Tech. Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the integrated circuit (IC) testing industry, offering wafer testing (Chip Probing) and chip final testing (Final Test) services. The company also provides related supporting services such as testing equipment leasing and sales of testing consumables. Their testing covers a wide range of chip types including CPU, GPU, MCU, FPGA, SoC, AI chips, RF chips, memory chips, sensor chips, and power chips, serving applications in communications, computing, automotive electronics, industrial control, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary IC testing technologies and advanced testing equipment platforms such as Advantest V93000, Teradyne J750, and Chroma. It has strong capabilities in developing complex SoC testing solutions and breakthroughs in testing high-end chips including high-computing-power chips, advanced architecture chips, and high-reliability automotive-grade chips. Production is highly automated with a self-developed production management system that enhances testing accuracy, efficiency, and data security. The company also focuses on R&D for testing schemes, hardware upgrades, and IT systems for automated and intelligent production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include over 200 chip design companies, wafer manufacturers, packaging companies, and IDM enterprises, with a significant portion being high-end chip design firms. Major clients include well-known domestic and international semiconductor companies such as Unisoc, ZTE Microelectronics, Fudan Microelectronics, Bitmain, SMIC, and others. The end markets served span strategic emerging industries like AI, cloud computing, IoT, 5G, high-end equipment, new energy vehicles, autonomous driving, and high-end consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with testing bases in Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuxi, Shenzhen, and Tianjin. Its sales and customer base are concentrated in the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta regions, extending north to Northeast China. The geographic focus aligns with major semiconductor clusters and facilitates close proximity to customers and supply chain partners.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai V-Test Semiconductor Tech. Co., Ltd. functions as an independent third-party IC testing service provider, positioned downstream in the semiconductor supply chain. It serves chip design, wafer fabrication, packaging, and IDM companies by providing wafer-level and final chip testing services, complementing upstream manufacturing and downstream application sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in high-computing-power chips (CPU, GPU, AI, FPGA), advanced architecture and packaging chips (SoC, Chiplet, SiP), and high-reliability automotive and industrial-grade chips. It emphasizes breakthroughs in testing process challenges, development of comprehensive testing solutions, and automation and digitalization of production. The company also focuses on talent acquisition and retention, patent development, and expanding R&D infrastructure including a new northern China R&D center in Tianjin.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of IC testing services, including wafer testing and chip final testing. The company adopts a direct sales model with long-term framework agreements with customers. Pricing is based on testing platform configurations and required labor hours. Additional revenue streams include leasing of testing equipment and sales of testing consumables.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading independent third-party IC testing enterprises in mainland China, competing with firms like Liyang Chip Testing and Hualing Integrated Circuit Technology. While the domestic market share of independent third-party testers is still relatively low compared to Taiwanese giants like King Yuan Electronics, Siliconware Precision, and Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Shanghai V-Test is recognized for its strong R&D capabilities, high-end testing capacity, and growing market presence. It aims to narrow the gap with international leaders and capitalize on the domestic market's rapid growth and localization trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.08 billion, representing a 46.21% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 128.23 million, up 8.67%. Total assets grew 36.33% to RMB 4.92 billion, and net assets increased 6.52% to RMB 2.62 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, with R&D expenses accounting for 13.22% of revenue. It maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by industry recovery, new customer ramp-up, and enhanced production utilization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai V-Test emphasizes its advanced testing technology, strong R&D capabilities, and high degree of production automation as key differentiators. It offers comprehensive testing solutions for a broad spectrum of chip types and advanced packaging technologies, enabling domestic substitution of imported testing services. The company’s strategic focus on high-end and high-reliability chip testing, coupled with its regional presence in major semiconductor clusters, allows it to provide fast, reliable, and cost-effective testing services tailored to customer needs, thereby enhancing customer satisfaction and loyalty.
